name: developer/implement-change
title: Implement Change
description: Take a bounded software change through verification and review evidence. Establishes context, inspects the working tree, runs the project's own verification, inspects the final diff, produces a structured impact summary, and records a durable handoff. It deliberately does NOT commit, push, merge, publish or release.

summary.description: What the bounded change is meant to accomplish

project.description: Canonical Sidekick project name for the handoff

base.description: Base ref for the final diff; omit to use working-tree changes

steps.name: working_tree
steps.title: Inspect the working tree before verification

args.title: Implementation: ${inputs.summary}
